CompanyDescription.label: Company Description
CompanyDescription.value: Churchill Downs Incorporated ('CDI') (Nasdaq: CHDN) has created extraordinary entertainment experiences for over 150 years, beginning with the Company's most iconic and enduring asset, Churchill Downs Racetrack, the home of the Kentucky Derby and premier races of the Thoroughbred Championship Series. Headquartered in Louisville, Kentucky, CDI has expanded through the acquisition, development, and operation of live and historical racing entertainment venues, the growth of the online wagering businesses, and the acquisition, development, and operation of regional casino gaming properties.
